name: PLANT-1 M13
notes: M13: EUCLID (hits over 2-16 steps with rotation, REC switches STYLE/EUCLID on the MOTIF page), MUTATE (hold GLO on MOTIF: a variation that keeps the rhythm), CHORD (hold REC on SEQ: every step plays root + third + fifth from the scale). Plus M12's motif generator and the K-knob readout.
